Job Summary

Provide training program and assessment for PTP Asset maintenance personnel, of mechanical and Auto- electrical / electronic trades, to ensure the personnel supervised are skilled up towards the identified competencies for the personnel's position, as well as to perform relief job roles for site training coordinator where necessary, and to comply with company policies and procedures.

Job Responsibilities

Key
Metric

Prepare and review weekly/monthly training report and then submit it to the Training Superintendent
Weekly and monthly training reports are successfully submitted to the Training Superintendent.

Develop, review and implement Mechanical and Auto-electrical/electronic Training and Assessment processes, and ensure its implementations in accordance with PTP training procedures at project sites.
The implementation of Training and Assesment processes are implemented in accordance with training procedures

Assist the site Training Coordinators to conduct TNA, site delivery of training, supervision for on-job training, personnel screening/selection in order to ensure that technical trades training is conducted in order to satisfy site PTP requirements.
Training coordinators are successfully assisted.

Develop and review Mechanical and Auto-electrical/electronic training modules, and assessments, in order to maintain the quality always meet the requirements for project sites.
Training modules are developed and reviewed.

Maintain and actively implement SHE programs and responsibility (involve identify, mitigate and monitor SHE risk), including SHE Management System to ensure the effectiveness of the programs conform to official standard, requirements and procedure applied and to confirm the execution of the SHE Responsibility meet the intended outcome
- SHE risk well maintained

- Target Zero LTI

- SHE Management System meets the current ISO 14001, ISO 45001, SMK3 & SMKP standards and requirements

Education

High School Graduate of Any major

Skill, Knowledge, and Experience

• Min. 2 years of working experience with operation training as trainer, especially in mining.
• Experienced working with various type and model of heavy equipment simulator.
• Already have TOT/WTAC Certificate.
• Good presentation and leadership skill.
• Willing to travel to all company sites.
• Excellent communication ability with regard to respected politic and culture
• Fluent in English, both
spoken and written is an advantage

Founded in 1966, Kalbe Farma (Kalbe) is the largest publicly-listed pharmaceutical company in Southeast Asia. As of end 2023, Kalbe’s extensive healthcare ecosystem encompasses a network of 47 companies, including subsidiaries, joint ventures, and associates, all driven by a dedicated workforce of 16,795 employees.

Guided by a vision to become the country’s best global healthcare company, Kalbe offers a comprehensive healthcare solution through its four key business divisions: prescription pharmaceuticals, consumer health, nutrition, and distribution & logistics. Within these divisions, Kalbe manages a diverse portfolio reinforced by a robust distribution network that serves over one million outlets across Indonesia’s vast archipelago.

On the international stage, Kalbe has established a strong presence in ASEAN countries, as well as regions spanning East and South Asia, the Middle East, and Africa. Kalbe’s business ventures are supported by best in- class research and development capabilities, developed through strategic alliances with many international partners. The Company is deeply involved in cutting-edge areas such as drug delivery systems, cancer treatment, stem cell research, and biotechnology.
